messages:
lauren_product: Quick sync — we need to lock launch criteria for the enterprise audit + BYOK work. Customers asking for exportable evidence, tenant-level separation, SOC2/ISO mapping, and retention controls. Thoughts?

 tom_pm: TL;DR: propose Pilot -> GA. Pilot = 3 customers (mix finserv + saas), BYOK opt-in, export NDJSON + signed manifest, basic retention tiers. GA = BYOK default, longer retention lanes, legal-hold UX.

 anika_legal: From legal: exports must include chain-of-custody metadata (key ids, signer, timestamps) and tamper-evident hashes. Need retention hold override flow for subpoenas. Also flag: any BYOK escrow requirements? :eyes:

 lauren_product: @anika_legal good call. Escrow only if customer explicitly requests (enterprise SLA). Default: customers manage their keys; we support KMS APIs + rotation metadata.

 mike_sre: Ops constraints: audit write availability target 99.95% for production. Export generation SLA: <= 2 hours for queries covering last 30 days; bulk archival for older ranges <= 24 hours. Also retention enforcement must survive region failovers.

 jordan_eng: Implementation sketch: stream events -> topic per-tenant -> immutable append-only object store (versioned) -> export worker that composes NDJSON + manifest (sha256 per file). BYOK: we support wrap/unwrap on ingest via customer KMS alias. Key metadata stored as tenant metadata only.

 lauren_product: Prioritization matrix idea: Must-haves vs Nice-to-haves. Must: per-tenant separation, immutable archives, exportable evidence with hashes, basic BYOK (wrap on write, key id in metadata), export SLA. Nice: per-request cryptographic receipts, HSM escrow, granular per-event access logs.

 tom_pm: Pilot acceptance criteria (proposal):
 - 3 pilot customers onboarded and performing exports
 - Export success rate >= 98% over 1 week
 - Sampled manifests verify (hash matches stored objects)
 - BYOK handshake completes and key rotations preserved in metadata
 - Ops runbook validated for legal-hold and restore flows

 anika_legal: Also require SOC2 evidence mapping: exports must map to control IDs (e.g., C5/A7) and include retention proofs. We should add a short template for customers to sign off acceptance.

 jordan_eng: Quick config snippet for retention tiers we can use in the pilot docs:
```json
{"retention_tiers": [{"name":"standard","days":365},{"name":"longterm","days":5400},{"name":"legal_hold","days":-1}],"export_sla_hours":2}
```

 mike_sre: Operational notes: add monitoring for export job duration, per-tenant failed export alerts, and a throttling policy to avoid large customers blocking the export pipeline. Alerting thresholds: export latency > 30m (warning), > 2h (pager).

 lauren_product: Risks/costs: long-term retention (5400d) storage costs and search/restore time. We should offer tiered pricing or require commit for long retention. Also BYOK handshake increases onboarding time — factor into onboarding SLA.

 tom_pm: Roadmap proposal (quarterly):
 - Q1: Pilot infra + 3 customers, basic BYOK, NDJSON export, runbook
 - Q2: GA: per-tenant encryption, retention billing lanes, SOC2 evidence template + automation
 - Q3: HSM escrow workflow (customer opt-in), export streaming API, improved search over archived logs

 lauren_product: Action items: @jordan_eng create pilot design doc + migration checklist, @mike_sre draft runbook + alerting playbook, @anika_legal prepare customer acceptance template + list of legal hold requirements. I'll schedule a 30m sync with pilot customers next week. :thumbsup:

 ops_bot: deploy-bot: Pilot namespace provisioned: infra-pilot-audit-01. Logs forwarded to kafka://pilot-audit.

 jordan_eng: I'll start the doc today and include sample curl commands for export and BYOK handshake. Example: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/{t}/audit/export?from=2025-01-01`

 anika_legal: One more ask: include a minimal privacy checklist for exported PII (redaction options) — some customers will require redaction by default.

 lauren_product: Noted. We'll make redaction a pilot toggle. Thanks everyone — moving this to the pilot lane. :rocket!
